dedupe_keys.name: reporting and hosting a dataset of high impedance faults in medium voltage covered conductors

description: Reporting and hosting a dataset of high-impedance faults in medium-voltage covered conductors is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Diogo Biasuz Dahlke et al. This work presents a multimodal dataset characterizing high-impedance faults (HIF) in medium-voltage covered conductors under controlled single-phase, phase-to-ground contact conditions. Insulation reduces wildfire risks but restricts fault currents below conventional detection thresholds. This restriction delays the onset of the fault signature. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
